title: Stuck in LRS Estimate
body:
Hi! I'm trying to test a 20 million byte-sized sample, but it gets stuck right after the t-tuple estimate. I tried reducing the sample size to 10 million, 5 million even to 1 million bytes, but it would always get stuck for hours/days. 
Though it works with 500 thousand bytes, I intended to get an estimate for the full 20MB.
